title: Why Your Fingers Wrinkle In Water

scenes.say: Your fingers don't wrinkle because they soak up water.
For years, people thought skin just swelled up with water.
scenes.heading: THE OLD IDEA

scenes.say: But doctors noticed something weird. People with nerve damage in their fingers don't wrinkle at all.
scenes.heading: THE CLUE

scenes.say: Your nervous system does it on purpose. It shrinks the blood vessels under your skin, and the skin folds.
scenes.heading: THE REAL REASON

scenes.say: In one study, people moved wet objects twelve percent faster with wrinkled fingers. Like tire treads in the rain.
scenes.heading: WET GRIP TEST

scenes.say: But another study found no difference at all. So scientists still argue.
scenes.heading: BUT...

scenes.say: And here's the weird part. Your fingers wrinkle in the same pattern, every time.
scenes.heading: THE WEIRD PART

scenes.say: Did you know it was your nerves?
